feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Some of the victims of the Nepal floods were pilgrims on a sacred journey
entry.summary: Many among the dead and missing in Nepal's devastating floods were pilgrims undertaking a sacred journey to a mountain.

entry.title: How the producer of 'Fleabag' creates hits at the Fringe
entry.summary: Before Baby Reindeer or Fleabag made it to the screen, they were small theater productions at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival. And behind both is a producer you've probably never heard of.

entry.title: What's the secret ingredient in these cookies? Plastic
entry.summary: New research at the American Chemical Society meeting showcased a potentially edible cookie made out of — plastic!

entry.title: Second death confirmed in Grand Canyon flooding, search for survivors continues
entry.summary: Officials at Grand Canyon National Park are still assessing damage and engaged in recovery efforts from weekend flash flooding.

entry.title: Jurors deliberate in the trial of rap icon Tupac Shakur's killing
entry.summary: Jurors said Duane Davis is guilty of murder in orchestrating the killing of Tupac Shakur. The rap star was gunned down in a gang-related drive-by shooting in Las Vegas in 1996.

entry.title: He offered strangers $10 to tie his shoe. Then things got weird
entry.summary: A Minnesota man promised $10 to anyone able to find him and tie his shoe. That was the least strange thing to happen.

entry.title: The trade war between the U.S. and Canada could affect key midterm elections
entry.summary: Canada is Maine's top trade partner. And the current trade war between the U.S. and Canada could affect key midterm races there as well as other states that rely heavily on trade with Canada.

entry.title: Scope of devastation in Nepal continues to grow
entry.summary: The latest on the floods in Nepal, where authorities now say more than 4,000 are currently considered missing — a sharp rise from the previous figures.

entry.title: Trump's plan for economic D-day for Iran has one big hole: China
entry.summary: The Trump administration says it's asking countries to voluntarily cut off business with Iran to squeeze its economy further. But the most critical country — China — already says it won't cooperate.

entry.title: Postpartum mental health needs a village
entry.summary: The Lindsay Clancy trial has shed new light in the dark corners of postnatal maternal health. We talk with a psychiatrist about women's mental health issues following childbirth.
